prompt.project_info: An airy, transparent Japanese summer-veranda portrait with nostalgic film softness.
prompt.main_subject: An adult Japanese woman with a natural dark-brown medium bob, minimal no-makeup look, subtle soft-pink blush, clear lip balm, and a gentle calm expression. She wears a loose sleeveless white linen summer dress with opaque lining and a relaxed natural drape.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level knee-up 3:4 portrait: she sits on a wooden engawa, knees hugged gently to chest with chin resting lightly on them, arms around shins, relaxed bare feet. Sliding glass doors open to a lush green summer garden; sheer white curtains blow softly behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Diffused overcast/window daylight at +1 EV creates high-key low contrast, soft wraparound light, bright square eye catchlights, clear summer breeze, and an ephemeral nostalgic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Contax 645 medium-format look, Carl Zeiss Planar 80mm f/2, shallow creamy bokeh, sharp eyes with gentle edge softness, Fujifilm Pro 400H palette, cyan-green shadows, lifted blacks, subtle grain, mild vignette and top-corner light leak.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If approved person, wardrobe, or engawa references are attached, preserve adult identity where appropriate, white lined linen dress, knee-hugging seated pose, veranda, garden, curtains, and high-key Pro 400H direction. Individual features and garden details may be replaced.
